description: Estimate the drive time of a Transfer or Transport segment (taxi, car service, airport transfer, ground transport) from its pickup and drop-off at its pickup time, using Apple Maps traffic prediction. apply=false (default) only reports the estimate; apply=true saves it as the estimated drop-off time so the Tineo calendar and iCal feed show the real ride length instead of a flat hour. A drop-off time already on the booking or set by the user is never changed, and a failed lookup changes nothing. Present the result as an estimate.

apply.description: Save the estimate as the drop-off time. Default false.

segment_id.description: ID of the Transfer or Transport segment.

name: estimate_transfer_drive_time
title: Estimate Transfer Drive Time
